request.style: English, choral, female solo voice with ethereal choir, harp, cello, flute, soft piano, reverent and comforting mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing
He lets me lie down in green pastures
He leads me beside still waters
He restores my soul so gently

[Chorus]
Even though I walk through the valley
Of the shadow of death, I fear no evil
For you are with me, always near
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me

[Verse]
You set a table before me
In the presence of my enemies
You anoint my head with oil
My cup overflows with grace

[Chorus]
Even though I walk through the valley
Of the shadow of death, I fear no evil
For you are with me, always near
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me

[Bridge]
Goodness and mercy will pursue me
All the days of my life
I will dwell in the house of the Lord
For length of days, for length of days

[Chorus]
Even though I walk through the valley
Of the shadow of death, I fear no evil
For you are with me, always near
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me

[Outro]
Your rod and your staff, they comfort me
For you are with me
